notes: Elasticsearch 9 single node, security disabled. One index per collection, every field indexed at mapping time (inverted index for keyword/text, BKD tree for numeric/geo, HNSW for dense_vector). Eventually consistent for search (30 s refresh; the harness refreshes after load). No multi-document transactions, no server-side joins across indices, no per-document TTL.

secondary_index.title: Create a secondary index on a non-key field and use it
secondary_index.detail: every field is indexed by default (inverted index / BKD tree / doc_values)

compound_index.title: Compound / composite index over two fields
compound_index.detail: bool query combines per-field indexes; no explicit composite index needed

unique_constraint.title: Unique constraint on a non-key field (duplicate rejected)
unique_constraint.detail: no unique constraint; _id uniqueness only (op_type=create rejects a duplicate _id)

ttl_expiry.title: Native per-document/key expiry
ttl_expiry.detail: per-document _ttl removed in 5.0; use an expiry timestamp + ILM rollover/delete or delete-by-query

text_index.title: Full-text index with tokenised search
text_index.detail: analyzed text fields with BM25 (the core feature)

partial_update.title: Update a single field without rewriting the document
partial_update.detail: _update with a partial doc or painless script (reindexes the document internally)

multi_doc_transaction.title: Multi-document / multi-key ACID transaction with rollback
multi_doc_transaction.detail: single-document atomicity only; no multi-document transactions

tunable_consistency.title: Per-request consistency / write concern / read preference
tunable_consistency.detail: wait_for_active_shards per write; refresh=true|wait_for|false for read-your-write visibility

nested_query.title: Filter on a field inside a nested object

array_operators.title: Query and update array-valued fields (contains, push)
array_operators.detail: arrays are first-class (a field is multi-valued); term query matches any element -> 1044 match 'eco'

server_side_join.title: Join / lookup between two collections inside the engine
server_side_join.detail: no server-side joins across indices (denormalise, parent/join field within one index, or terms-lookup)

graph_traversal.title: Variable-depth traversal over references
graph_traversal.detail: no graph traversal (client-side, or X-Pack Graph explore API)

schema_validation.title: Server-enforced document schema / constraints
schema_validation.detail: explicit mappings + dynamic:strict rejects unknown fields; field data types enforced at index time

change_streams.title: Change feed / watch / keyspace notifications
change_streams.detail: no change feed; poll with a sorted timestamp/_seq_no or use Logstash/change-detection

server_side_scripting.title: Stored procedures / Lua / JS / UDF executed by the server
server_side_scripting.detail: Painless scripts (ingest pipelines, script queries, script fields, _update) -> 2

pubsub.title: Publish/subscribe messaging built into the engine

explain_plan.title: Query plan / profile output for a query
explain_plan.detail: _validate/query?explain and Search Profile API (per-shard query/collector timings, took=2ms)

bulk_import.title: Native bulk import path (bulk API, batch, COPY-like tool)

large_document.title: Store and read back a 15 MB document / value
large_document.detail: 5 MB _source stored (http.max_content_length 100 MB; large text hurts search)

many_fields.title: Document with 5000 top-level fields
many_fields.detail: index.mapping.total_fields.limit default 1000; 5000 distinct fields triggers mapping explosion (use flattened type)

read_from_replica.title: Client can direct reads to a replica / secondary
read_from_replica.detail: reads are served by any shard copy (primary or replica) automatically; ?preference= pins routing

snapshot_backup.title: Online snapshot / backup command available
snapshot_backup.detail: snapshot API into an fs repository under path.repo (S3/GCS/Azure via repository plugins); SLM schedules + retention (exercised in the backup phase)

incremental_backup.title: Incremental / differential backup (file- or segment-level)
incremental_backup.detail: repository stores each Lucene segment once: every snapshot after the first only uploads new segments

pitr.title: Point-in-time recovery from a continuous change log
pitr.detail: no translog replay between snapshots — the RPO is the SLM schedule

slow_query_log.title: Server-side slow-query log with a configurable threshold
slow_query_log.detail: per-index search/indexing slowlog thresholds (index.search.slowlog.threshold.query.warn ...), dynamic, JSON lines with took_millis + source

audit_log.title: Audit / full-query log of statements or auth events
audit_log.detail: xpack.security.audit.enabled needs security enabled (off in this lab); JSON audit of auth/access events

structured_logs.title: JSON-structured server log out of the box
structured_logs.detail: ECS JSON on stdout in the docker image (server, deprecation, slowlog datasets)

runtime_log_level.title: Change log verbosity at run time (no restart)
